blocks.text: Accommodation: 4 nights in Rio de Janeiro, 2 nights in Paraty and 2 nights on Ilha Grande. On the island, accommodation is at Vento Sul or a similar hotel.
The exact dates of the Carnival trip, the type of show and the Sambadrome seating section are confirmed at booking.
The return boat trip to the Caixa d’Aço natural pool and lunch at Vagalume restaurant on Ranchos Beach are paid for separately.
The boat trip on day 7 is unguided. The guide language for the other excursions is confirmed at booking.
Breakfast is listed for days 2, 3 and 5. Other meals are confirmed at booking.

Welcome to Brazil!

When you arrive at Rio de Janeiro’s international airport, your driver will meet you and take you to your hotel.

As the plane descends over Rio, look out over the city from above. Known as the Marvelous City, Rio brings together green hills, turquoise waters, sandy beaches and modern high-rises.

The drive to your hotel gives you a different view, passing colonial-style buildings and some of the city’s best-known beaches. The tropical greenery recalls the Amazon rainforest, and the city has the energy and charm of Latin America.

Walk along Copacabana’s black-and-white mosaic promenade to get a feel for the rhythm of life among the cariocas, as Rio’s residents are known. Sip a cold caipirinha to the sound of the surf, watch a lively game of beach football and see the crowds soaking up the sun on the white sand. It’s a fitting introduction to Rio.
